title: Auto Loans: loan terms, base APR and credit-grade adders
content:
# Auto Loans: loan terms, base APR and credit-grade adders

This rate sheet covers the pricing inputs of every Auto Loans product at PCB: the loan terms offered, the base APR for each term, the percentage points added for each credit grade, and the credit grades underwriting may approve on the product.

## Meaning of the entries

- **Terms offered**: the loan terms, in whole months, from which the term is chosen.
- **Base APR by term**: the APR, in percent, before credit-grade adders and before any discount.
- **Credit-grade adder**: percentage points added to the base APR for the grade assigned by underwriting (grades A to D).
- **Eligible credit grades**: the grades underwriting may approve on the product.

## Base APR by term (percent)

| Auto Loans product | 36 months | 48 months | 60 months | 72 months | 84 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 7.49 | 7.74 | 7.99 | 8.49 | not offered |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 6.74 | 6.99 | 7.24 | 7.74 | not offered |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 6.99 | 7.24 | 7.49 | 7.99 | not offered |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 6.89 | 7.14 | 7.39 | not offered | not offered |
| New Vehicle Loan | 5.99 | 6.24 | 6.49 | 6.99 | 7.49 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 5.49 | 5.74 | 5.99 | 6.49 | 6.99 |

A term marked "not offered" is not among that product's term options: the Used Vehicle, Certified Pre-Owned and Auto Refinance Loans offer 36, 48, 60 and 72 months; the Lease Buyout Loan offers 36, 48 and 60 months; the New Vehicle and Green Vehicle Loans offer 36, 48, 60, 72 and 84 months.

## Credit-grade adders and eligible grades

| Auto Loans product | Grade A adder | Grade B adder | Grade C adder | Grade D adder | Grades underwriting may approve |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 0.00 | 1.50 | 3.50 | 6.00 | A, B, C, D |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 | A, B, C |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 | A, B, C |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 | A, B, C |
| New Vehicle Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 | A, B, C, D |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 0.00 | 1.25 | 3.00 | 5.50 | A, B, C, D |

## Reading the sheet

**A Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan shows a grade D adder of 5.50; can grade D be approved on it?** No. The adder is listed, but grade D is not among the grades underwriting may approve on that product (A, B and C only). The same holds for the Auto Refinance and Lease Buyout Loans.

**Lookup illustration (hypothetical application):** a New Vehicle Loan over 60 months at grade B reads a base APR of 6.49 and an adder of 1.25 percentage points; a Used Vehicle Loan over 60 months at grade B reads 7.99 and 1.50. These are the two inputs before any discount.
